extraction.name: NWPU-RESISC45
extraction.description: A large-scale benchmark dataset for remote sensing image scene classification containing 31,500 images across 45 scene classes.
extraction.creator: Northwestern Polytechnical University (NWPU)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was extracted from Google Earth by domain experts in remote sensing image interpretation.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images from Google Earth, which consists of superimposed satellite imagery, aerial photography, and GIS data.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Images were manually labeled into classes based on pixel percentage thresholds (e.g., tiles with at least 85% coffee pixels were assigned to the coffee class, while those with less than 10% were assigned to the non-coffee class).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has lower spatial resolutions for certain scene classes, specifically island, lake, mountain, and snowberg.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset advances remote sensing image scene classification, which plays an important role in various societal and environmental applications such as natural hazards detection, environment monitoring, and urban planning.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended to be used as a large-scale benchmark for training, testing, and evaluating data-driven algorithms and deep learning models for remote sensing image scene classification.
